data: Capital Markets - Trading, Analysis and Investment Strategy

This dynamic capital markets course transforms students from market observers to informed investors through hands-on trading simulations, real-time market analysis, and portfolio management. Students will navigate the complexities of stock markets, bond markets,
derivatives, and alternative investments while building practical skills in financial analysis, risk assessment, and investment strategy. The course culminates in a Portfolio Management Competition where students present their investment strategies to a panel.
Learning Objectives:
1. Understand the structure and functioning of global capital markets
2. Master fundamental and technical analysis techniques for investment decisions
3. Develop practical skills in portfolio construction and risk management
4. Gain hands-on experience with trading platforms and financial data analysis
5. Learn to evaluate and present investment strategies effectively
